newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan stocks closes slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan stocks closes slightly lower.

text.p: Casablanca stock exchange closed on Friday 0.08 percent lower with little volume traded on both the official and the over-the-counter markets and ONA losing ground, stockbrokers said.
The bourse all-share index closed at 646.74 from 647.27 points on Thursday.
ONA, the biggest Moroccan private conglomerate, dropped 14 dirhams to 800 dirhams.
In the banking sector, Banque Commerciale du Maroc was unchanged at 890 dirhams while Wafabank advanced 10 dirhams to 820 dirhams.
Credit firms, Credor rose five dirhams to 761 dirhams and Maghrebail 15 dirhams to 533 dirhams.
First tranche of privatisation bonds, issued in January 1996, went up 10 dirhams to 1,380 dirhams while their second issue dating back May 1996, was up three dirhams to 1,207 dirhams.
SNI, Societe Nationale d'Investissement, the second largest private group, was up three dirhams to 748 dirhams.

In the energy sector, mining firm Societe Metallurgique d'Imiter dipped two dirhams to 558 dirhams while oil refinery Samir was unchanged at 354 dirhams.It accounted for main trade on the official market with more than 3,000 shares exchanged.
Total traded volume on the official market was 18.5 million from 29.4 million dirhams.
On the over-the-counter market, the volume was 11.8 million from 11.4 million dirhams. Steel mill Sonasid took the biggest part of trade with 3,700 shares changing hands.
